source_refs.note: Exercise 13.1, Question 10 (book page 248, PDF 253); answer key PDF 310-311. Key's 10(b) 13/3 km/h is wrong; correct 13 km/h.

blocks.prompt: 10 (a) The position of a car after \(t\) hours is given by: \(s(t) = 2t^3 - 3t^2 + t\) (in kilometers). Find the average velocity over the interval \([1, 4]\).
blocks.explanation:
Average velocity ka matlab: poore safar mein kul kitna faasla tay hua, use kul waqt se divide karo. Jaise koi 3 ghante mein 84 km jaye to average 28 km/h.
Yahan koi limit nahi chahiye, sirf do values aur ek division.
Plan: \(s(4)\) aur \(s(1)\) nikalenge, phir \(\frac{s(4) - s(1)}{4 - 1}\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(s(t) = 2t^3 - 3t^2 + t\) km, waqt \(t = 1\) se \(t = 4\) ghante.
Find karna hai: average velocity.
Tareeqa: \(v_{\text{avg}} = \frac{s(t_2) - s(t_1)}{t_2 - t_1}\) (Section 13.2.1). Graph par yeh secant line ki slope hai, jo do points ko jorti hai.

Dono kinaron par position
\[s(4) = 2(64) - 3(16) + 4 = 128 - 48 + 4 = 84\]
\[s(1) = 2 - 3 + 1 = 0\]
Kyun: \(t = 4\) aur \(t = 1\) ko position formula mein rakha. \(4^3 = 64\), \(4^2 = 16\). \(s(1) = 0\) ka matlab hai \(t = 1\) par car shuru wale point par hai.

Average velocity
\[v_{\text{avg}} = \dfrac{s(4) - s(1)}{4 - 1}\]
\[= \dfrac{84 - 0}{3} = 28\]
Kyun: Faasle ka farq (km) ko waqt ke farq (ghante) se divide kiya, is liye unit km/h hai. Neeche \(4 - 1 = 3\) ghante hain, \(4\) nahi: yeh aam ghalti hai.

Tasdeeq
\[28 \times 3 = 84 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(28\) km/h ki raftaar se \(3\) ghante mein \(84\) km banta hai, jo position ka farq hai.

blocks.prompt: 10 (b) The position of a car after \(t\) hours is given by: \(s(t) = 2t^3 - 3t^2 + t\) (in kilometers). Find the instantaneous velocity at \(t = 2\).
blocks.explanation:
Ab "instantaneous velocity", yani bilkul \(t = 2\) wale lamhe ki raftaar, jo car ka speedometer us waqt dikhata.
Yeh derivative \(s'(2)\) hai: bohat chhote interval \([2, 2 + \delta t]\) ki average velocity, jab \(\delta t \to 0\).
Plan: \(s(2 + \delta t)\) kholenge, \(s(2)\) minus, \(\delta t\) se divide, phir limit.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(s(t) = 2t^3 - 3t^2 + t\), \(t_1 = 2\).
Find karna hai: \(v(2) = s'(2)\).
Tareeqa: kisi lamhe \(t = t_1\) par instantaneous velocity (usi lamhe ki raftaar) derivative hai: \(v(t_1) = \lim_{\delta t \to 0} \frac{s(t_1 + \delta t) - s(t_1)}{\delta t}\) (Section 13.2.1). Matlab: bohat chhote time interval ki average velocity, jab woh interval zero ki taraf jaye. Exercise 13.1 mein hum yeh limit khud nikalte hain.

\(s(2)\) aur \(s(2 + \delta t)\) nikalein
\[s(2) = 16 - 12 + 2 = 6\]
\[s(2 + \delta t) = 2(2 + \delta t)^3 - 3(2 + \delta t)^2 + (2 + \delta t)\]
\[= 16 + 24\,\delta t + 12(\delta t)^2 + 2(\delta t)^3\]
\[\quad - 12 - 12\,\delta t - 3(\delta t)^2 + 2 + \delta t\]
\[= 6 + 13\,\delta t + 9(\delta t)^2 + 2(\delta t)^3\]
Kyun: Cube aur square ke formulas se brackets khole: \((2 + \delta t)^3 = 8 + 12\,\delta t + 6(\delta t)^2 + (\delta t)^3\), jise \(2\) se multiply kiya; \((2 + \delta t)^2 = 4 + 4\,\delta t + (\delta t)^2\), jise \(-3\) se. Phir like terms jama kiye: \(\delta t\) ki terms \(24 - 12 + 1 = 13\), \((\delta t)^2\) ki \(12 - 3 = 9\).

Minus karein aur \(\delta t\) se divide
\[s(2 + \delta t) - s(2) = 13\,\delta t + 9(\delta t)^2 + 2(\delta t)^3\]
\[\dfrac{s(2 + \delta t) - s(2)}{\delta t} = 13 + 9\,\delta t + 2(\delta t)^2\]
Kyun: \(6\) cancel ho gaya. Har term mein \(\delta t\) hai, is liye \(\delta t\) se divide kiya (woh abhi zero nahi). Yeh chhote interval ki average velocity hai.

Limit lein
\[v(2) = \lim_{\delta t \to 0}\big(13 + 9\,\delta t + 2(\delta t)^2\big)\]
\[= 13\]
Kyun: \(\delta t = 0\) rakha to sirf \(13\) bacha. Unit km/h hai, kyunke km ko ghante se divide kiya.

Tasdeeq
\[s'(t) = 6t^2 - 6t + 1\]
\[s'(2) = 24 - 12 + 1 = 13 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: General derivative \(6t^2 - 6t + 1\) mein \(t = 2\) rakha to bhi \(13\) aaya. Is liye \(\frac{13}{3}\) ghalat hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key part (b) ka jawab \(\frac{13}{3}\) km/h chhapti hai. Yeh ghalat hai: \(s'(2) = 6(4) - 6(2) + 1 = 13\), is liye instantaneous velocity \(13\) km/h hai. (Part (a) ka \(28\) km/h sahi hai.)
